body:
Bounded experiment completed: 2000-update pi0.5 LoRA SFT, seed42/batch1, preserving all old corrections plus 40-task public replay and 2 approved converted expert demonstrations.

Negative result on 12 reused development initial states: freshly rerun parent 9/12; candidate 6/12. Placement recovery 1/4 -> 0/4. On 6 jointly successful states median controls 92.5 -> 166.5. Both predeclared gates failed. No UI promotion, no heldout or ordinary 40-task retention claim. Demonstration execution success does not imply policy recovery success.

Artifacts: osc-sft29-training-pairs.tar.gz contains the two added expert Parquets and combined manifests; osc-sft29-inference-adapter.tar.gz contains compact inference weights, normalization and metadata. Official pi05_libero base weights are required for reconstruction. Optimizer/resumable full checkpoint remains local; this Release is not a full training-resume checkpoint.

Report and paired videos: https://github.com/sencangWei/pi05-rl-handson/blob/experiment/matched-recovery-20261027/reports/osc-sft-20261029/README.md
